spanish: Y toda mujer sabia de corazón en sus manos hilaron, y trajeron hilado el azul y la púrpura, el carmesí y el lino fino.
grammarChanges: Changed the verb from singular 'hiló' to plural 'hilaron' to carry the qal perfect 3rd common plural force of טָווּ, per the singular-head-noun/plural-verb choice allowance.
readerNote: Chose the plural verb hilaron to carry the Hebrew's plural טָווּ, even though the head noun toda mujer is grammatically singular in Spanish.
